title: BNCI 2015-006 Music BCI dataset
description: EEG recordings from 11 healthy participants performing a multi-streamed musical oddball task with polyphonic music clips (Synth-Pop and Jazz). Participants selectively attended to one of three concurrent instruments and counted its deviant patterns while ignoring the others. The data support research on auditory brain-computer interfaces, showing that attended instruments can be classified offline from single-trial EEG (P300 and early auditory responses) with a mean accuracy of 91%.
methods_description: 64-channel active-electrode EEG (Brain Products actiCAP, 10-10 montage, left mastoid reference) was recorded at 1000 Hz while participants listened to 40-second polyphonic music clips and attended to a cued instrument. Data were downsampled, low-pass filtered (Chebyshev, 42 Hz), epoched (-200 to 1200 ms), baseline corrected and artifact rejected. Classification used LDA with shrinkage covariance and leave-one-clip-out cross-validation.
